name: toroid_small_shield_lossless
notes: Replica of the 2022 COMSOL model Small_Shield.mph (arXiv:2211.00008, shielded lossless toroid): square section R 0.5-1.0 m, z 0-0.5 m, 2.5 cm PEC walls revolved 0-355 deg (5 deg gap at 355-360, interior open to the gap); PEC bridge strip on the outer face R = 1.0, z 0.240-0.241, phi 354-361 deg (COMSOL: zero thickness; here 0.2 mm radially outward); lumped port phi 357.00-357.01 deg in the strip; closed PEC cylinder shield R 1.5 m, z -0.25..0.75. Design history: v0 modelled the shield as a 2 cm superconducting shell inside a closed PEC sphere (R 1.65); the 3D mesher rejected it (the static infinity shell [R/1.25, R] cut the shell). v1 uses fullwave.rf_only with mesh.domain_solid = the shield's interior cylinder (R 1.5, z -0.25..0.75), so the PEC shield is the outer boundary exactly as in COMSOL (no outer cavity, no spurious modes), and mesh.remove_pec so the PEC walls are holes, as in COMSOL (not meshed). v2: the bridge strip is its own superconductor region 'bridge' (same body as the sheath after remove_pec) with surface_size 3e-4 m. Reason: with the strip inside 'sheath' (surface_size 0.02) the 1 mm x 0.2 mm x 12 cm strip was meshed only by its own geometry (61 slivers, gamma < 0.05, all at the strip) and its partial inductance (~140 nH of ~775 nH) was under-resolved: L(5 MHz) rose 746 -> 766 nH (order 1) on refining the strip; 3e-4 -> 1.5e-4 changes L by 0.13%. mesh.threads 16 (gmsh HXT; 1 thread took 18.5 min for the v1 mesh, 2.5 min with 16). Solver: AXF_FW_SOLVER=strumpack; order 2 must NOT use AXF_FW_GAUGE=tree-cotree (lowest-order only); order 1 may.
